activities.title: Parameter Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify which values are learned during training and which are configured before training.

content.concept: Model parameters are learned from training data, while hyperparameters control the learning process and are configured before training.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Controls the size of parameter updates during optimization.
Controls the maximum depth of a decision tree.
Controls how many trees are created in an ensemble.
Controls the strength of a regularization constraint.

activities.title: Grid vs Random
activities.instruction: Compare how grid search and random search explore hyperparameter configurations.

content.concept: Grid search evaluates predefined combinations, while random search samples configurations from specified ranges or distributions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Random Search → Samples configurations from specified ranges
Grid Search → Can become expensive as the number of combinations grows
Random Search → Can explore a larger search space with a fixed evaluation budget
